description: EODHD symbols for identifiers of the 110-name 2016 PIT universe that the rule in mci_gru/data/eodhd_prices.py default_symbol cannot map: renamed, reused, predecessor and delisted tickers (#281). Each segment lists candidate symbols tried in order, then EODHD's US listings whose company name contains name_hint. When the pull is given the preserved LSEG panel, a candidate is accepted only if its returns agree with that panel over the span the universe needs, so a wrong guess here stops the pull rather than entering the panel. Dates are inclusive and follow the listing changes. An entry may instead declare unavailable, with the reason the vendor holds no history for that identifier; it then has no rows in the panel. An entry may also declare adjustments (a corporate action the split records miss, such as a spin-off: prices before the date are multiplied by factor; by 1 - cash / the last close before the date when cash per share is given; or by the step in EODHD adjusted_close on that date when neither is given; share_conversion also divides earlier volume by the factor) and accepted_differences (dates whose one-day difference from the reference is explained); each needs a reason.

CAM.N^D16.note: Cameron International, acquired by Schlumberger 2016-04-01; EODHD files it as CAM_old (CAM_old1 is Camco).

CB.N^A16.note: The Chubb Corporation, acquired by ACE on 2016-01-14; ACE then took the CB ticker. EODHD's CB.US is ACE/Chubb Ltd for the whole history; the old company is CB1.

CHTR.OQ.note: Charter Communications. When the Time Warner Cable merger closed on 2016-05-18, each legacy Charter share became 0.9042 shares of the new Charter. EODHD's pre-merger closes are the legacy closes times 0.9042 and its 4521/5000 split record on that date only divides that back out, so its split records do not carry the conversion itself (#347).

adjustments.reason: Legacy Charter shares converted 0.9042 for 1 (5000/4521) in the Time Warner Cable merger, so earlier prices are restated per new share and earlier volume, counted in legacy shares, is converted to new shares. EODHD +11.85% against LSEG +1.11% that day in the first EODHD pull of 2026-10-08; 0.9042 reproduces LSEG's +1.11% (r1 and r2 used 0.9). The vendor's volume does not carry the conversion or the split record: its 21,642,600 on 2016-05-17 equals Yahoo's, which records no split there (#347).

Found in the first EODHD pull of 2026-10-08; the name is absent from the panel. A data config using the package declares it in data.pit_absent_kdcodes, and admission then keeps it off the stock axis.

adjustments.reason: $0.65 supplemental dividend paid with the regular $0.15. EODHD's split-only prices drop with it and the LSEG panel does not: -5.63% against -0.86% that day in the first EODHD pull of 2026-10-08. adjustments.reason: Spin-off of Care Capital Properties (one CCP share per four VTR) effective 2015-08-18. EODHD records it as a 8757/10000 split, which raises the earlier prices instead of lowering them, so its split-adjusted close falls 23.57% that day against 0.33% in the LSEG panel. The factor (1-0.2357)/(1-0.0033) puts the day on LSEG's basis.
